Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite animation atlas for a first-person fresco horror shooter, not a concept screenshot. Style is DOMINANT reference B: functional matte blackened iron, charcoal plates with ash-gray edge highlights, dull dark walnut, sparse oxblood cloth, extremely sparse scratched votive marks. Medieval Italian fresco/tempera depiction of a physical gun; brush pigment, ochre underpainting, controlled shadow masses. NO shiny gold bands, no chrome, no glowing runes, no magic, no skull-face receiver, no anime, no surrounding scene, no text, no labels. Fine detail remains subordinate to an instantly readable silhouette at small game resolution. EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 distinct poses, wide fully transparent gutters between all cells, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Equal scale, same single physical gun and same two human hands in dark articulated iron gauntlets, natural anatomy. Forearms end on the SAME baseline near bottom of each equal cell. Camera always first-person looking forward along barrel, no third-person object view. All cells use exactly the same material and lighting. No muzzle flashes, no smoke and NO airborne cartridge cases anywhere; these are separate game effects. The 2nd input is an OLD layout only, replace ornate designs. First input is approved dominant style. Reloading hands cover ammunition count whenever rounds are being loaded so partial reloads remain honest. Main weapon: break-action side-by-side DOUBLE BARREL SHOTGUN. Two thick smooth parallel iron barrels with simple joining rib, functional breech latch and hinge, dark wooden stock. No decorative face or big medallion. Centre holds forward muzzle above grip, all images match orientation.
Read left to right:
Row1: (1) ready aligned forward, two hands low supporting gun; (2) restrained recoil lift still fully shut; (3) return from recoil fully shut; (4) left hand starts reach toward breech latch, still shut.
Row2: (5) thumb at latch, shut; (6) latch unlocked gun tilting to open, barrel hinge almost shut; (7) visibly BROKEN OPEN, barrel block tipped forward exposing two empty chamber openings; (8) same open barrel block, left hand reaches beneath receiver.
Row3: (9) left closed cupped hand comes over open breech, ammunition concealed in palm; (10) palm/fingers cover both chambers during insertion, gun stays OPEN; (11) fingers press over both chamber openings concealing rounds; (12) still OPEN with fingertips over breech and partial withdrawal, ammo faces concealed.
Row4: (13) gun visibly OPEN, hand moving back to fore-end, chambers occluded by angled breech and hand; (14) gun partly closing, STILL obvious hinge gap, no fully closed gun; (15) barrels fully closed and latched, hands returning to grip; (16) settled ready position matching first cell.
Every cell composition registered to the same wrist baseline. Exactly sixteen isolated sprites. Transparent background.

Loading hand hides the speedloader and exact number of rounds, palms may cover openings during insertion. No loose rounds outside hands.
Read left to right:
Row1: (1) ready forward down sights; (2) restrained recoil muzzle lifted; (3) settling recoil; (4) ready held firmly.
Row2: (5) left hand reaches release latch, cylinder still closed; (6) thumb works latch with barrel tilted left slightly, cylinder just unlocked; (7) cylinder clearly swung open left, six EMPTY holes visible; (8) open cylinder, left hand operates extractor, no cases drawn.
Row3: (9) left cupped hand approaches open cylinder, ammo hidden inside closed palm; (10) palm covers whole cylinder face, pushing in concealed rounds; (11) thumb and fingers press, cylinder still visibly open but face covered; (12) hand withdraws slightly, cylinder STILL OPEN, face partly hidden by fingers.
Row4: (13) cylinder visibly OPEN with hand ready to close, rearward viewpoint hiding chamber contents; (14) cylinder moving inward but STILL clear gap separating cylinder from frame; (15) cylinder fully CLOSED, left palm pushes it home; (16) both hands back in ready grip like first cell. Exactly sixteen isolated sprites. Transparent background.
integration: Lossless pixel atlas packing only, no repaint/filter. 16 isolated 400x400 cells, 1600x1600 PNG, grip at (200,330); source transparent gutters measured per row; original source pixels retained. Script: work/weapon-v16-measure. Source copies: work/art-proposals-v16/*-generated-source.png.
